lessons.trigger_condition: Every supervisor tick rereads label stores; learning failures retry each minute and runtime HOLD loses the training clock. Provider Retry-After dates and waits beyond 24 hours are shortened.
lessons.prevention_rule: Reuse only successful exact-build readiness for at most fifteen minutes, keep source/HTTP checks live, retry failed learning after five minutes, preserve learning clocks across runtime HOLD, and honor both HTTP Retry-After forms across restart. Select preview HTTP header values only from constants.
validation_required: 15 healthy minute ticks perform one label scan while all 15 source/HTTP checks remain live
Error cooldown, explicit fresh status, build change, invalid/future clocks and recovery after HOLD
48/72-hour and HTTP-date provider cooldown persistence, expired cooldown, unchanged quotas, preview and CSP regressions
Exact historical/source hashes and current-head CI; physical tablet readback remains separate
lessons.safety_boundary: No invented labels, lowered class/time/holdout gates, new timer, paid provider, cloud training, runtime code rewriting or physical-device claim.
